name: Haus Sonnenhang
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Sonnenhang is located in a quiet village in Tirol, Österreich. The rooms are functionally furnished and have a balcony or terrace. The in-house restaurant serves breakfast and regional evening dishes daily. There are hiking trails in the surrounding area and, in winter, ski slopes nearby. Guests can use the garden and the terrace to relax. There is access to public transport. The stay at the inn is characterized by a quiet atmosphere and personal service.
